# listmonk_subscriber (Resource)

Manages a listmonk subscriber and its list memberships. Meant for a handful of well-known addresses (seed, test or internal recipients), not for bulk audiences: use listmonk's import for those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_list" "internal" {
  name = "Internal seed list"
}

# A seed address that receives every campaign sent to the internal list.
resource "listmonk_subscriber" "seed" {
  email                    = "seed@example.com"
  name                     = "Seed inbox"
  lists                    = [listmonk_list.internal.id]
  preconfirm_subscriptions = true

  attributes = jsonencode({
    team = "marketing"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) E-mail address. listmonk stores it in lower case; case-only differences are not drift.

### Optional

- `attributes` (String) Custom attributes as a JSON object, e.g. `jsonencode({ city = "Utrecht" })`.
- `lists` (Set of Number) IDs of the lists the subscriber belongs to. Lists not in this set are unsubscribed. Defaults to no lists.
- `name` (String) Name of the subscriber. When unset, listmonk derives one from the e-mail address.
- `preconfirm_subscriptions` (Boolean) Confirm subscriptions to double opt-in lists without sending an opt-in e-mail. Applies when lists are added. Defaults to `false`.
- `status` (String) `enabled`, `disabled` or `blocklisted`. Defaults to `enabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the subscriber.
- `subscription_status` (Map of String) Subscription status per list ID (`unconfirmed`, `confirmed` or `unsubscribed`).
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the subscriber.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Subscribers are imported by their numeric ID.
terraform import listmonk_subscriber.seed 42
```
